## Content and devotional review

- [ ] Tamil text reviewed by a competent human reviewer where changed
- [ ] English meaning/transliteration reviewed where changed
- [ ] Deity, temple and tradition claims cite approved sources
- [ ] “Verified” and “Needs Review” labels are evidence-based
- [ ] Rights/provenance for new media is recorded

## Deployment and rollback

- [ ] No secrets or environment-specific credentials are committed
- [ ] Deployment is scoped to the intended environment
- [ ] Health and security-header checks are defined
- [ ] Rollback trigger and exact rollback action are documented
- [ ] Post-deployment smoke-test owner is identified
